lines.label: HOT TAKE
lines.text: Your expiration spreadsheet is *not* a system

lines: It only works if someone *remembers* to open it
That person goes on vacation. Or quits.
Then a license lapses and *nobody* noticed
Dates don't need a memory. They need *alerts*.

cta.title: Stop relying on memory
cta.body: CertTrack tracks every license, permit and policy and alerts you before it expires.
